title: Galante 1967 AF equilibrium free swelling in different solutions

quantity.name: swelling ratio (swollen / original weight)
quantity.definition: equilibrium (fully swollen, up to 32 h) wet weight / fresh weight of 20 x 5 x 1 mm anterior AF samples immersed at room temperature; distilled water equilibrates in 2 h, others in 5 h

source.sample: 40 anterior AF samples (20 x 5 x 1 mm) from 4 lumbar spines, 10 per solution (study total: 592 samples from 68 autopsy lumbar spines)

protocol.summary: Free swelling: samples weighed fresh, immersed in solution at room temperature, re-weighed (blotted 5 s) at 5 min to 32 h
how_to_simulate: Simulate free swelling of a thin AF slab in solutions of different osmolarity (water vs 0.15 M NaCl vs colloid)

extraction.check_notes: Table IV read from 150-dpi render (OCR corrected: distilled water original SE 0.0054; NaCl swollen weight 0.1824). Values mean +- SE (n=10 each). Ratio = mean swollen / mean original computed by extractor.
